integrity: Two standalone Python programs using distinct projective-plane constructions and distinct rowmotion implementations; all integer counts are tested exhaustively.
scientific_limitations: An exact finite enumeration of one 26-element poset, with no claim for other plane orders or birational dynamics; historical publication overlap cannot be excluded completely.
title: Rowmotion on the ternary projective-plane incidence poset: 6,202 cycles in 22 projective symmetry types
